summary: An undergraduate computer scientist who has taken discrete mathematics, linear algebra, algorithms and introductory theory of computation. They know asymptotic notation, divide-and-conquer recurrences, basic number theory (divisibility, gcd, modular arithmetic, primes, Chinese remainder theorem statement), matrices and linear maps, complex numbers and roots of unity, and simple multitape Turing machines. They have not studied the FFT-based multiplication literature in depth, Nussbaumer or Bluestein transforms, fine tape-machine permutation tricks, or finite-ring and numerical-error analysis beyond basics.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers taken modulo m, with a mod b the remainder of a on division by b.

known.name: Greatest common divisor and coprimality
known.gloss: The gcd of two integers is their largest common divisor, and they are coprime when it equals 1.

known.name: Prime numbers
known.gloss: Integers greater than 1 with no divisors other than 1 and themselves, and every integer factors uniquely into them.

known.name: Floor and ceiling functions
known.gloss: The floor and ceiling of x are the nearest integers at or below and at or above x.

known.name: Binary logarithm
known.gloss: lg n is the base-2 logarithm, the number of bits needed to write n.

known.name: Binary representation and bit strings
known.gloss: Writing nonnegative integers in base 2, and dyadic rationals as integers divided by powers of two.

known.name: Exclusive or
known.gloss: The bitwise operation that is 1 when exactly one input bit is 1, equal to addition mod 2.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Linear maps between vector spaces represented by matrices, with composition as matrix multiplication and inverses for invertible ones.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: A bijective rearrangement of a finite list of positions.

known.name: Subspaces, dimension and rank
known.gloss: Linear subspaces of a vector space, their dimension, and the rank of a matrix as the dimension of its image.

known.name: Cyclic groups and rings
known.gloss: The integers mod m under addition and multiplication, and the basic notion of a ring with addition and multiplication.

known.name: Cartesian products and tuples
known.gloss: Ordered tuples of elements from several sets, used to index multidimensional arrays.

known.name: Subsets and combinatorial counting
known.gloss: Counting and indexing subsets of a fixed size from a finite set.

known.name: Recurrences and geometric series
known.gloss: Solving recursive cost relations by unrolling levels and summing a geometric series.

known.name: Inequalities and error bounds
known.gloss: Bounding sums and products of quantities by absolute value and the triangle inequality.

known.name: Gaussian integers
known.gloss: Complex numbers a+bi with integer a and b, closed under addition and multiplication.

known.name: Exponents and powers
known.gloss: Powers such as 2^k and x^c, and manipulating real exponents like (lg n)^(1-kappa).

known.name: Sorting and scanning arrays
known.gloss: Standard sorting and sequential traversal of lists of records.

known.name: Schoolbook multiplication
known.gloss: The standard digit-by-digit multiplication method taking quadratic time.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform
known.gloss: The divide-and-conquer algorithm computing a length-N discrete Fourier transform in O(N log N) operations.
